description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development - Revoked of appointment of the Industrial Dispute between Inter Company Employee's Union and Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC and N. H. A. Somapala Pahala Biyanwila. Appointed Mr. S. Kariyawasam, as the Arbitrator of the settlement of Industrial Dispute between Inter Company Employee's Union and Chevron Lubricants Lanka Plc. N. H. A. Somapala Kadawatha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act, including the revocation of a previous order and the appointment of an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between a union and companies/individuals. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory powers, and regulatory actions rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
